name: cta-band
title: CTA Band
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: The dark close. Statement left, capture slot right. The slot is a render prop, not an import, because a capture form belongs to the project's funnel.
docs: Differs from the jhai-new-website original, where the right slot renders GraderField, JHAI's audit-email capture. That form is a funnel, not reusable UI, so it stays project code. Pass your own component as `field`, pass `link` for a click ask instead, or pass neither for the statement-only shape.
